I need Brick to build roads toward the Node 3 Wheat Port or Node 50 3:1 Port, but the Brick source (H5) is blocked by the robber. Alice and Charlie are teaming up against me. I'll try to trade my surplus Wood for Charlie's potential Brick or just end the turn if no one bites. Since Charlie said he has no clay, I will try to see if Alice has any or just end.
